name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_type_1_diabetes_mellitus_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_type_1_diabetes_mellitus_inthehistory@@duration_in_years
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of years since the patient was first diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration in years since diagnosis is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of years since the patient was first diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus, if known.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypoglycemia_inthepast12months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had hypoglycemia in the 12 months prior to enrollment.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had at least one episode of hypoglycemia in the 12 months prior to enrollment.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had any episodes of hypoglycemia in the 12 months prior to enrollment.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had hypoglycemia in the 12 months prior to enrollment.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypoglycemia_inthepast12months@@documented
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment are documented.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment are documented.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment are not documented.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the hypoglycemia episodes are documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypoglycemia_inthepast12months@@severe
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment are severe.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment are severe.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment are not severe.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the hypoglycemia episodes are severe.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypoglycemia_inthepast12months@@episode_count
meaning: Numeric count of documented, severe hypoglycemia episodes in the 12 months prior to enrollment.
when_unknown: Set to null if the episode count is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of documented, severe hypoglycemia episodes the patient has had in the 12 months prior to enrollment.

name: duration_of_continuous_glucose_monitor_use_before_screening_in_months
meaning: Numeric value indicating the number of months the patient has used a continuous glucose monitor prior to the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many months the patient has used a continuous glucose monitor prior to the screening visit.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient has used a continuous glucose monitor prior to the screening visit.

name: patient_has_used_continuous_glucose_monitor_consistently_for_at_least_3_months_before_screening
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has used a continuous glucose monitor consistently for at least 3 months prior to the screening visit.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has used a continuous glucose monitor consistently for at least 3 months before the screening visit.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not used a continuous glucose monitor consistently for at least 3 months before the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has used a continuous glucose monitor consistently for at least 3 months before the screening visit.

name: patient_has_undergone_transplantation_of_pancreatic_islet_cells_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone transplantation of pancreatic islet cells at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone transplantation of pancreatic islet cells at any time in the past (prior to now).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone transplantation of pancreatic islet cells at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone transplantation of pancreatic islet cells in the past.

name: patient_has_undergone_solid_organ_transplant_to_recipient_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a solid organ transplant at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a solid organ transplant at any time in the past (prior to now).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a solid organ transplant at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a solid organ transplant in the past.

name: patient_has_undergone_cell_therapy_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone any cell therapy at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone any cell therapy at any time in the past (prior to now).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone any cell therapy at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone any cell therapy in the past.
